TableGateway.goal: Represent one sheet as one logical table.
TableGateway.description:
Acts as the data mapping gateway for a spreadsheet sheet.
Handles column mapping, type-casting normalization, and physical row operations via the underlying SheetDataSource.

TableGateway.constructor.description:
Binds the logical sheet table name, SchemaRegistry, and SheetDataSource.
Pre-loads the primary keys, table category, and schema configurations.

TableGateway.all.goal: Fetch all records as normalized objects.
TableGateway.all.description:
Queries and pulls all active rows from the spreadsheet sheet.
Normalizes and parses cell types according to the schema registry.

TableGateway.isTableExist.goal: Check if the table physically exists in the spreadsheet.
TableGateway.isTableExist.description:
Queries the SheetDataSource to verify if the physical sheet for the table exists.
Allows repositories to bypass queries on un-provisioned tables.

TableGateway.find.goal: Find a single record by its primary key.
TableGateway.find.description:
Finds and returns a normalized row object matching the primary key.
Utilizes optimized row lookup filters to bypass table scanning.

TableGateway.where.description:
Filters sheet rows in memory using key-value pair checks.
Enforces strict comparisons and parses columns to matching schema types.

TableGateway.findOne.goal: Finds the first record matching the filters.
TableGateway.findOne.description:
Runs matching filters on the sheet rows and yields the first matching row object.
Returns null if no matching records exist.

TableGateway.count.description:
Computes the count of sheet rows matching filter criteria in memory.
Fast count validation check.

TableGateway.insert.description:
Appends a new normalized row into the spreadsheet.
Performs data serialization and primary key checks before writing.

TableGateway.insertBatch.goal: Performs an optimized batch insertion of multiple records.
TableGateway.insertBatch.description:
Groups multiple records into a single physical batch insert call to SheetDataSource.
Drastically reduces write time for large transactions.

TableGateway.update.goal: Update an existing record by ID.
TableGateway.update.description:
Updates cell values for a specific row in the spreadsheet sheet.
Locates row indices and applies changes matching the primary key.

TableGateway.remove.goal: Physically remove a record by ID.
TableGateway.remove.description:
Evicts the physical spreadsheet row matching the primary key.
Updates row ranges and triggers cache evictions for the table.

TableGateway.deleteMany.goal: Delete multiple records by their primary keys.
TableGateway.deleteMany.description:
Evicts multiple spreadsheet rows matching IDs in a single operation.
Minimizes Apps Script sheet updates using contiguous row deletions where possible.

TableGateway.updateMany.description:
Processes updates for multiple records using a mapping of IDs to data payloads.
Performs write calculations and updates the sheet in bulk.

TableGateway._mapObjectToRow.goal: Maps an object to a 2D row array based on the physical spreadsheet header order.
TableGateway._mapObjectToRow.description:
Converts an object payload into a raw row array matching the physical sheet header order.
Inserts default values for unprovided fields.

TableGateway._normalizeRow.goal: Casts raw spreadsheet values to schema-defined types.
TableGateway._normalizeRow.description:
Inspects raw sheet cell arrays and converts them into schema type-cast objects.
Handles date strings, integers, booleans, and floats.

TableGateway._castValue.description:
Converts raw string values from cells into javascript equivalents.
Uses isDate() cross-realm utility for date checking.

TableGateway._prepareForWrite.description:
Serializes javascript values (dates, objects) into storage-friendly formats.
Ensures compatibility with Google Sheets cell storage.
